regime: Forced selling in metals with silver under extra stress, oil above $100 and a tech-led slide building
takeaway: Gold slipped below $4,000 and silver fell about 4% to near $50, pushing the gold/silver ratio up to about 79, while bitcoin dropped about 3.6% as well. Nasdaq futures were down about 2% after Amazon and Intel results, and the 10-year yield eased to 4.91% as money moved into bonds. Brent rose about 1% to near $116 on Houthi attacks on Saudi oil sites.
